lyrics:
[Intro: shimmering synth arpeggio, tom fill]

[Verse 1: airy male falsetto]
Phone on silent, shoes by the door
Left a message at a quarter to four
Said I'm feeling under the weather
Under it's right. I've never felt better.

[Pre-Chorus: synths rising]
Is it wrong? Is it wrong?
It's too blue out to belong indoors

[Chorus: full shimmer, falsetto stacked]
I called in sunny
Told them I can't come in
Got a bad case of the sky today
And it's getting under my skin
Called in sunny
Don't wait up, don't call
I'll be floating till the light gives out
And I'm not sorry at all

[Verse 2: falsetto, bass pulsing]
Emails pinging in a drawer somewhere
Meetings melting in the midday air
Twenty years I never took a day
Turns out the building stood up anyway

[Chorus: full shimmer, falsetto stacked]
I called in sunny
Told them I can't come in
Got a bad case of the sky today
And it's getting under my skin
Called in sunny
Don't wait up, don't call
I'll be floating till the light gives out
And I'm not sorry at all

[Bridge: half-time, synths wash over]
Out of office (out of office)
Out of reach (out of reach)

[Final Chorus: brightest, extra harmony on top]
I called in sunny
Told them I can't come in
Got a bad case of the sky today
And it's getting under my skin
Called in sunny
Don't wait up, don't call
I'll be floating till the light gives out
And I'm not sorry at all

[Outro: arpeggio, one splash]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, E-flat major. Bright, gliding and weightless.

VOICE: Male falsetto, airy and smooth, in two- and three-part stacks throughout the choruses. The verses are a single soft voice. Echoed answers in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: A shimmering, chorused synth arpeggio, strummed acoustic guitar doubling the chords, a tight live-sounding kick and snare, a pulsing eighth-note synth bass, glassy pads, toms in the fills.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro arpeggio. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:34 Pre-chorus. 0:42 Chorus 1. 1:14 Verse 2. 1:38 Chorus 2. 2:10 Bridge, half-time. 2:26 Final chorus. 2:58 Outro, arpeggio and a splash at 3:12.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2000s synth-pop made airy: bright, wide and glossy, lots of reverb on the voices, drums crisp.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Got a bad case of the sky today' at 0:50.

STATION FIT: 10 a.m., when the pool starts to fill. The brightest vocal track of the morning, good after a run of instrumentals.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Guilty, giddy, free, floating.
